payload.core_composition_summary: Sliding window with two pointers grows/shrinks range; monotonic deques per type track max values to efficiently check total shot cost ≤ k.
payload.rationale: Code uses two-pointer sliding window over droids; for each type, a deque acts as monotonic queue to get current window max in amortized O(1), enabling fast constraint validation.
